evals.name: mirror-and-bump
evals.prompt: external-ebs-autoresizer 0.7.0 릴리즈 완료되면 이미지 및 차트 미러링하고 전환경 차트 범프
evals.expected_output: Confirms the workflow run succeeded, or states run history is purged and gates on the source registry (OCI index with linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, chart version present); copies the multi-arch index without `--platform` on the copy; picks crane copy or the in-cluster skopeo Job by the 200 MB per-platform layer rule and cleans up any Job and Secret; verifies digests; bumps every environment keeping overrides and leaves the wrapper chart version unchanged; ships via git-ship; never names the public source registry in internal text.

evals.name: status-failure
evals.expected_output: Reports run URL and per-job result when a run exists, otherwise states run history is purged and judges each recent release from the source registry; quotes a decisive error line only for an actual failed run and never invents one; does not retry or re-tag automatically.

evals.name: status-only-scope
evals.expected_output: Runs only the Status stage; does not mirror or bump unasked.

evals.name: published-name-differs
evals.expected_output: Resolves the published image and chart name `kuo` from the release workflow and Chart.yaml instead of the directory name; reports image 0.6.0 (from the Dockerfile version label) and chart 0.7.0 (from Chart.yaml) present in the source registry with both platforms in the image index; does not treat them as missing; does not mirror or bump.
